---
title: "Penguins Model"
format: html
---

Load Libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pins)
library(vetiver)
```

Load in the Data

```{r}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(), 
  dbdir = "my-db.duckdb"
  )
data <- dplyr::tbl(con, "penguins") |>
  collect() |>
  drop_na()

head(data, 3)
```

Model

```{r}
model <- lm(body_mass_g ~ bill_length_mm + species + sex, data = data)
```

##Results 
R^2
```{r}
summary(model)$r.squared

```
Intercept and Coefficients

```{r}
summary(model)$coefficients
```

Column names used in the model matrix

```{r}
colnames(model.matrix(model))
```

Create a vetiver model
```{r}
v <- vetiver_model(model, "penguins_model")
```

Save to Board
```{r}
model_board <- board_folder("~/data/model", versioned = TRUE)

vetiver_pin_write(model_board, v)
```

```{r}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```
